sources.title: TE Oscar Delp would be a perfect fit for the Broncos
sources.description: One prospect who may interest the Denver Broncos in the second round of the 2026 NFL Draft is Georgia tight end Oscar Delp. He is a 6-5, 245-pound prospect who is considered one of the better tight ends in the draft and has loads of untapped potential as a receiver. Delp was not utilized much […]
